description: This Java source file defines the class ThingsAggregatorProxyActor, an Akka actor that acts as a client proxy for an internal aggregator actor and handles retrieval requests for thing entities by managing message flow, processing responses, and streaming data via Akka streams.

classes.name: PlainJson
classes.description: A helper class within ThingsAggregatorProxyActor representing an entity's JSON string along with its ID, used for processing streamed thing data.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props configuration object for Akka actor instantiation.

methods.name: stopTimer
methods.description: Utility method to stop a StartedTimer instance.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior with pattern matching for various message types.

methods.name: handleRetrieveThings
methods.description: Handles incoming RetrieveThings messages by initiating retrieval from the target actor.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrieveThings
methods.description: Handles SudoRetrieveThings messages similarly to handleRetrieveThings but for sudo requests.

methods.name: askTargetActor
methods.description: Sends an ask request to the target actor and processes its response, managing SourceRef handling.

methods.name: handleSourceRef
methods.description: Processes SourceRef responses containing streamed thing data, converts and sorts data, and assembles the final response.

methods.name: supplyPlainJsonFromRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a function to extract PlainJson from RetrieveThingResponse objects.

methods.name: supplyPlainJsonFromSudoRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a function to extract PlainJson from SudoRetrieveThingResponse objects.

methods.name: supplyPlainJsonSorter
methods.description: Provides a comparator-based sorter for PlainJson objects to match the order of their corresponding ThingIds.

methods.name: supplyRetrieveThingsResponse
methods.description: Generates a function to assemble RetrieveThingsResponse from a list of PlainJson objects.

methods.name: supplySudoRetrieveThingsResponse
methods.description: Generates a function to assemble SudoRetrieveThingsResponse from a list of PlainJson objects.
